description: Responsible for implementing spatial partitioning, collision detection, and resolution algorithms optimized for massive entity counts.
responsibilities: Implement a grid-based spatial hash map to efficiently query nearby entities
Implement AABB (Axis-Aligned Bounding Box) and Circle overlap algorithms
Build a basic collision resolution system
Ensure physics systems operate purely on flat component data (e.g., updating Float32Lists of positions/velocities)
context: Must handle thousands of interacting bodies. Algorithms must avoid object allocation during updates, relying on pre-allocated spatial grids and index lookups.
